summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Peixe Esperto Expo/RN app. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases passed covering auth (register/login/me, duplicate 409, wrong pass 401, no-token 401), bankrolls CRUD, bets CRUD, cross-device persistence (login-again returns same data), data isolation (user B cannot see/edit user A resources), casas default+custom, and soft-delete cascade. Frontend: mobile viewport 390x844, executed end-to-end flow via Playwright — register new account -> lands on empty Bancas -> create bankroll via header + -> tap card opens Painel with period tabs (Hoje/Semana/Mês/Tudo work using real keys 1d/1s/1m/1a) -> FAB opens add-bet -> casa selector shows 20 default houses and custom casa via search+add persists and gets selected -> save bet -> Apostas tab groups by month/day -> tap bet card opens BetSheet -> change status to Ganha updates -> edit bankroll via gear works -> logout from Mais returns to login. No red screens, no page errors. Only cosmetic React Native Web warnings (shadow* / pointerEvents deprecated) that are harmless.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: styles across screens using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius (search /app/frontend/**)
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking. Reference: navigation/tabs area (some library or component still uses the old prop)

action_items: Optional: migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow across StyleSheet definitions to silence RN Web console warnings
Optional: replace props.pointerEvents usages with style.pointerEvents
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: clean() mutates dicts in-place and pops owner_id/deleted_at which is fine for GET responses; POST create_bankroll/create_bet correctly insert doc.copy() before cleaning — good.
server.py: get_current_user maps HTTPBearer 401; me/no-token returns 403 due to HTTPBearer auto_error (test accepts 401/403). Consider unifying to 401 for consistency.
server.py: DEFAULT_CASAS uses .copy() during register — user list is independent per user (correct).
No pagination on list endpoints (to_list 500/5000); acceptable at this scale.
Frontend testIDs cover all major interactions; period tabs use keys 1d/1s/1m/1a (Portuguese labels displayed correctly).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of core flows (register, create bankroll, add bet with custom casa, change bet status, edit bankroll, period tabs, logout)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_ users/bankrolls/bets created and cleaned up within the pytest run; also created UI test user TEST_ui_<ts>@example.com and one bankroll+bet under existing neto@test.com account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file is /app/backend/tests/test_peixe_esperto_api.py — reuse it. Frontend BASE URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Period tab testIDs are period-1d / period-1s / period-1m / period-1a. Create-bankroll modal uses testIDs bankroll-name-input / bankroll-capital-input / bankroll-save. FAB is fab-add-bet. BetSheet status buttons are status-Pendente/Ganha/Perdida/Reembolsada.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Original cross-device persistence issue is verified fixed: after login on a second token/session, the same bankroll & bet are returned (test_cross_device_persistence).
